subject: general
question: A cricketer's average score in 12 innings is 52 runs. In the 13th innings, he scores 183 runs. His average score increases by _____. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in 12 innings = 12 × 52 = 624

Add 13th inning: 624 + 183 = 807

New average = 807 ÷ 13 ≈ 62.08

Increase = 62.08 − 52 ≈ 10.08

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 12 innings = 52

Runs in 13th inning = 183

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 12 innings = 12 × 52 = 624

⇒ Total runs in 13 innings = 624 + 183 = 807

⇒ New average = 807 ÷ 13 ≈ 62.08

⇒ Increase in average = 62.08 − 52 = 10.08

⇒ Rounded value = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

Total from Average

Total = Average × Number of terms

Increment Concept

Increase = New average − Old average

Rounding Rule

If decimal ≥ 0.5, round up; otherwise round down
